2026_04_NYJ_CHI.headline: Braelon Allen steps into New York’s backfield as Chicago turns to Tyson Bagent
2026_04_NYJ_CHI.paragraph1: New York reaches Chicago without Breece Hall, leaving Braelon Allen to carry a larger rushing role alongside Geno Smith and Garrett Wilson, while Minkah Fitzpatrick returns to strengthen Aaron Glenn’s defense. The Bears are also reshuffling: Caleb Williams and left tackle Braxton Jones are out, with Tyson Bagent expected to start after Chicago’s convincing win over Philadelphia. Ben Johnson must protect a backup quarterback behind a changed line, while the Jets need Allen to keep their offense balanced despite multiple missing starters.
2026_04_NYJ_CHI.model_rationale: Both offenses are absorbing important absences, making protection, rushing efficiency and turnover avoidance especially important as Chicago changes quarterbacks and New York reshapes its backfield.
